## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run lint` passes
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `bun test` passes
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Change stays inside the scope fence — it does not cross the Non-goals (v1) list in
      the README (no PR management, no background watcher or timer, no forge other than
      GitHub and no GitHub access bypassing `gh`, no multi-PR or multi-repo dashboard, no
      configuration file, no ticket-tracker integration, no notifications)
